name: moonweb-site
description: Monorepo for hub/infra/smarthome/code/retro/timecapsule (Eleventy, static, deployed to IONOS SFTP)

scripts.build:timecapsule: cd timecapsule && rm -r _site 2>/dev/null; npx @11ty/eleventy && rm -r ../dist/moonweb/timecapsule 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p ../dist/moonweb/timecapsule && cp -r _site/timecapsule/* ../dist/moonweb/timecapsule/
scripts.build:moonweb: npm run build && npm run build:timecapsule
